title: TraceMap Code
subtitle: Evidence-first research workspace · source & engineering
titleZh: TraceMap 源代码与开发原型
summary: An implementation-first engineering prototype of TraceMap with a FastAPI evidence API, a React Flow workspace, local tests and CI. Real LLM and production authentication are not yet implemented.
summaryZh: TraceMap 的可运行开发原型：FastAPI 证据服务、React Flow 研究工作台、自动测试与 CI。真实 LLM、生产认证和正式部署仍未实现。
problem: Research documents and a PRD cannot validate engineering feasibility alone: source anchoring, safe edits and undo need real code and repeatable tests.
thesis: Build the evidence and controlled-editing loop first, then test model quality and real user value before expanding features.
risks: Development identity tokens are insecure by design and production mode is disabled
PDF parsing is synchronous and not sandboxed; not suitable for public exposure
Generation and Patch use rule-based demonstrations, not a real LLM
No real Xmind import compatibility test or customer adoption metrics
method: Live implementation repository and CI; stage labels do not imply production deployment, model accuracy, customer usage or product-market fit.
